title: 2026 tariffs: not yet checked against the Gazette
body: Toll tariffs were adjusted on 1 March 2026 (SANRAL +3.12%, Government Gazette Nos. 54087 and 54088). Every price in Toll-E matches SANRAL's official 2026 tariff publication and the TRAC and Bakwena tariff pages. A person has not yet checked them against the Gazette itself, so they are still marked Unverified. The amount shown at the plaza is what you pay.

title: N3 tariffs under review
body: N3 Toll Concession's website and SANRAL's 2026 tariff poster show different N3 tariffs. Toll-E shows the poster figures and marks every N3TC plaza as under review until the Gazette is checked.

title: Gauteng e-tolls have ended
body: E-toll gantries on Gauteng freeways were switched off at midnight on 11 April 2024, so Toll-E includes no e-toll charges. In June 2026 Cabinet approved writing off historical e-toll debt; amounts already paid are not refunded.

title: Card payments are now tap-to-pay
body: News reports say SANRAL plazas stopped accepting magstripe (swipe) cards from 1 December 2025 in favour of contactless bank cards and mobile wallets. American Express, Diners Club and RCS cards are reported as not accepted. Cash and SANRAL tags remain accepted.
